name: Two-Plane Diffusion Model (TPDM)
definition: A method for solving 3D inverse problems by training two separate 2D diffusion models (primary and auxiliary) on perpendicular planes and alternating their usage during the denoising process to maintain 3D consistency.
summary: TPDM solves 3D inverse problems by training two 2D diffusion models on perpendicular planes, avoiding the curse of dimensionality while maintaining 3D consistency.
